5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.0: Keeps a small journal of every new person they meet.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.1: Refuses to sleep without a lit candle nearby.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.2: Collects odd trinkets and ties them to their belt.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.3: Talks to themselves quietly when they think no one listens.

5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.5: Starts each day with a quiet meditation or prayer.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.6: Cannot stand to see a door left ajar.

5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.20: Whistles the same tune when thinking deeply.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.21: Taps their fingers in complex patterns when idle.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.22: Never uses anyone's actual name, always nicknames.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.23: Collects rocks from every place they visit.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.24: Insists on sleeping under the stars whenever possible.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.25: Reads the same book over and over for comfort.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.26: Always polishes their boots before important events.
5edndnpc.backstory.quirks.27: Speaks to animals as if they can understand perfectly.

5edndnpc.features.sneakAttack.descriptio:
Once per turn, you can deal an extra {dice}d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. The attack must use a finesse or a ranged weapon.

You don't need advantage on the attack roll if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't incapacitated, and you don't have disadvantage on the attack roll.
